title: China: Beijing, Xi'an & Shanghai
summary: Three cities, three centuries apart — the Great Wall and the Forbidden City in Beijing, the buried army outside Xi'an, and Shanghai's skyline lit up across the Bund.
highlights: Walking the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall
Beijing's hutongs and the Forbidden City
The Bund at night, facing Pudong's skyline

itinerary.title: Arrive in Beijing
itinerary.description: Settle in near the Forbidden City, then a first full day inside it.

itinerary.title: The Great Wall
itinerary.description: A guided morning on the Mutianyu section, quieter and less rebuilt than the closer sections.

itinerary.title: Beijing's hutongs
itinerary.description: A bicycle ride through the old alleyways, ending at a local courtyard-home dinner.

itinerary.title: Xi'an
itinerary.description: A high-speed rail transfer, then the Terracotta Army and the old city wall.

itinerary.title: Shanghai
itinerary.description: A flight to Shanghai, the Bund at night, and a day trip out to a nearby water town.

itinerary.title: Depart Shanghai
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.

included: All internal flights and high-speed rail transfers
A local guide in every city
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
